name_for_human: 開物 Kaiwu — 中文 AI 搜尋
description_for_human: Chinese-world web search for AI agents: uncensored, Traditional/Simplified, LLM-ready. 專為 AI agent 打造的中文搜尋 API。
description_for_model: Use Kaiwu to search the Chinese-language web (Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, overseas Chinese) with uncensored international engines and automatic Traditional/Simplified expansion. POST https://kaiwu.dev/v1/search with Authorization: Bearer kw_<key> and body {query, search_depth: 'basic'|'advanced', include_answer, max_results, lang}. Use POST /v1/extract to get clean markdown from URLs. Results are LLM-ready. Get a key at https://kaiwu.dev/dashboard (free tier 1,000 credits/month). Read https://kaiwu.dev/llms.txt first.
